Tests the ability to design cross-region replication with tenant isolation and deterministic replay under partitions and failures.

- Multi-region Kubernetes Native Architecture (KCNA) replication

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you rotate per-tenant encryption keys without disrupting replication?
- What is the tradeoff between synchronous and asynchronous replication for bounded-latency reads?
- How do you handle region failover when the global sequencer becomes unavailable?
